scripts.typecheck: bun --bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun --bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && bun --bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && bun --bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tools/lit-check/tsconfig.json && bun run check:lit && bun run test:lit-check && bun run check:ts-unitban && bun run test:ts-unitban
scripts.test: bun run build:forgejo && bun run test:frontend:prepared && bun run test:forgejo:prepared
scripts.test:frontend: bun run build:forgejo && bun run test:frontend:prepared
scripts.test:forgejo: bun run build:forgejo && bun run test:forgejo:prepared
scripts.test:lit: bun run build:forgejo && SODA_LIT_BROWSER=1 bun test --timeout 120000 tests/forgejo/lit-*.test.ts tests/frontend/drawer-controls.test.ts tests/frontend/project-environment-controls.test.ts tests/frontend/project-access-controls.test.ts tests/frontend/workspace.test.ts tests/frontend/workspace-attention.test.ts tests/frontend/workspace-navigation.test.ts tests/frontend/workspace-persistence.test.ts tests/frontend/workspace-layout.test.ts tests/frontend/workspace-first-use.test.ts tests/frontend/workspace-setup.test.ts tests/frontend/workspace-recovery.test.ts tests/frontend/workspace-responsive.test.ts tests/frontend/terminal.test.ts tests/frontend/terminal-retirement.test.ts tests/frontend/terminal-end.test.ts tests/frontend/terminal-stream.test.ts
scripts.build:forgejo: cargo run --release --locked -p soda-release-assets --bin soda-fetch-terminal -- --out .artifacts/browser-terminal/vendor && bun scripts/build-forgejo.ts
